name: Fikajy
description: Fikajy ERP - Gestion de stock professionnel
author: Fikajy ERP <sdrrakt@gmail.com>

scripts.electron:dev: NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron . --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer --enable-features=UseOzonePlatform --ozone-platform=wayland"
scripts.electron:prod: npm run build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production electron .
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist/ release/ node_modules/.vite dist-electron/ dist-final/
scripts.clean:all: rm -rf dist/ release/ dist-electron/ dist-final/ node_modules/
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:win32: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --win --ia32 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux --x64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:linux-arm: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --linux --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:mac-arm: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:all: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder -mwl --config electron-builder.yml
